data.one_liner: Unifies confetti particle animations, haptic feedback, and synthesized sounds in a single API call.
data.what_it_does: Provides animated confetti particle presets, showcase modes, built-in synthesized audio clips, and smart haptic patterns. It can be used via a simple one-liner function call or embedded directly into widget trees using a controller.
use_when: You need celebratory confetti particle effects with matching haptics and sounds.
You want a zero-configuration solution for dialog or screen completion celebrations.
avoid_when: You require complex game physics or full game engine capabilities.
You only need standard animations without particle physics.
strengths: Bundles 10 original synthesized audio clips with no external asset setup required.
Supports multiple animation presets and custom particle shapes.
Zero-config one-liner API along with a manual controller option.
weaknesses: Limited to confetti and celebration-style visual effects and particles.
Depends on specific audio and web packages for its sound capabilities.
data.setup_notes: No extra asset declarations or native permissions needed; works out of the box.

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose lottie if you prefer vector-based animation files for celebrations and UI illustrations.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose flutter_animate if you want general-purpose widget animations and transitions rather than particle confetti.
